label: Semantic Models & DAX
title: Semantic Models & DAX
description: Original practice questions authored for the Hansa corpus integration from the open MicrosoftLearning course labs (mslearn-fabric, PL-300) and Microsoft Learn documentation. Covers storage modes and Direct Lake, relationships and star-schema design, DAX evaluation context and time intelligence, calculation groups and field parameters, incremental refresh, model security and the XMLA endpoint. No video anchors: every question is documentation-grounded, not video-derived.

label: Eventstream & Windowing
title: Eventstream & Windowing
description: Original practice questions authored for the Hansa corpus integration from Microsoft Fabric Real-Time Intelligence documentation harvested by the deep-research corpus, in dialogue with the site's own RTI Academy lessons. Covers the streaming-engine choice, eventstream sources and destinations, transformations and derived streams, KQL windowing semantics (tumbling, hopping, sliding, session), event time versus ingestion time, materialized views, alerting and eventstream lifecycle. No video anchors: every question is documentation-grounded.

label: Dataflow Gen2
title: Dataflow Gen2
description: Original practice questions authored for the Hansa corpus integration from Microsoft Fabric Data Factory documentation harvested by the deep-research corpus. Covers Dataflow Gen2 positioning and data destinations, staging and compute, refresh and monitoring, gateway-backed sources, pipeline orchestration with the Dataflow activity, CI/CD, and Gen1 migration. No video anchors.

label: Mirroring
title: Mirroring
description: Original practice questions authored for the Hansa corpus integration from Microsoft Fabric mirroring documentation harvested by the deep-research corpus. Covers what mirroring replicates and for which sources, how the mirrored copy is stored and queried, replication lifecycle and retention, cost characteristics, CI/CD, and the comparison against shortcuts and pipelines. No video anchors.

label: Activator & Alerts
title: Activator & Alerts
description: Original practice questions authored for the Hansa corpus integration from Microsoft Fabric Activator and Real-Time Hub documentation harvested by the deep-research corpus. Covers what Activator is, where its data comes from (streams, dashboards, semantic models, querysets), how rules and triggers work, the actions it can take, and its lifecycle surfaces (Git, capacity, monitoring). No video anchors.

label: Notebooks & PySpark
title: Notebooks & PySpark
description: Original practice questions authored for the Hansa corpus integration from Microsoft Fabric Data Engineering documentation harvested by the deep-research corpus. Covers notebook authoring and languages, Spark compute and environments, lakehouse data access, orchestration with notebook activities and Spark job definitions, the Livy API, source control, and Delta/PySpark operations on lakehouse tables. No video anchors.

label: Incremental Copy & Watermarking
title: Incremental Copy & Watermarking
description: Original practice questions authored for the Hansa corpus integration from Microsoft Fabric Data Factory documentation harvested by the deep-research corpus. Covers the watermark pattern for incremental copy, pipeline activities that implement it (Lookup, Script, ForEach, Set variable), Copy job's managed incremental option, comparison against mirroring and dataflow incremental patterns, and run operations. No video anchors.
